title: Tiếng Việt trong kinh tế và kinh doanh

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develops proficiency in Vietnamese language, including vocabulary, grammar, and economic terminology.
Enhances communication skills in Vietnamese, including listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
Improves critical thinking and problem-solving skills related to language use.
Fosters teamwork and collaborative skills in language learning activities.
Develops skills in finding and using information related to economic topics.
Increases understanding of business culture and economic practices in Vietnam and internationally.
